info.submission: Implementation of ChangeCalculator using bottom-up dynamic programming: validates negative totals ("Negative totals are not allowed."), returns empty list for 0, deduplicates/sorts coins, and throws "The total N cannot be represented in the given currency." when unreachable. Passed public-suite plus a standalone harness replicating all 13 original tests (including the @Disabled ones the grader enables) and extra edge cases (empty coin list, unordered coins, total 10000). Saved as candidate-001.
